articles.summary: Before a customer ever sets out on the open road, there’s a different kind of journey happening behind the scenes. It’s one built on internal and external partnerships, problem-solving and collaboration. For Brooke Eggert, it’s a journey she lives every day as a senior category manager in enterprise strategic sourcing for Winnebago Industries.
articles.title: Driving every moment together: How Brooke Eggert helps keep production moving
